title: Indian Market News Brief — 07 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Falling oil prices and returning foreign investors may support the stock market and strengthen the rupee. Higher festive spending by shoppers and strong new orders for engineering companies also bring good news. However, mixed profit margins in some business segments keep short-term trends watchful.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Stock markets on fire; Sensex jumps 1,718 points, Nifty reclaims 25,000
stories.summary:
The Indian stock market jumped sharply on Friday.
The Sensex rose 1,718 points and the Nifty crossed the 25,000 level.
The rise was supported by foreign investor buying and falling crude oil prices.
This was the seventh straight day of gains for the benchmark indices.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Lower oil prices and buying by foreign investors may boost confidence in Indian shares.

stories.headline: Indian rupee strengthens past 94/$ as oil slides, foreign inflows return
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee rose past 94 against the US dollar.
The gain came due to falling crude oil prices and strong foreign investment in Indian shares.
Foreign investors have returned to Indian stocks.
The Reserve Bank of India also announced measures to support the currency.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: A stronger rupee and cheaper oil reduce costs for Indian companies and can attract more foreign investment.

stories.headline: सरकार ने 2026-27 के लिए OMSS (D) के तहत चावल की बिक्री का लक्ष्य 25 LMT से दोगुना करके 50 LMT किया, 31 अक्टूबर 2026 तक ई-नीलामी के ज़रिए 25 LMT चावल पहले ही बेचा जा चुका है
stories.summary:
The Indian government doubled its rice sale target under the open market sale scheme to 50 lakh metric tonnes for 2026-27.
It had earlier set a target of 25 lakh metric tonnes.
By October 31, 2026, the government had already sold 25 lakh metric tonnes through electronic auctions.
The step aims to increase supply in local markets.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Selling more rice in the market can keep food prices stable and help control overall prices for consumers.

stories.headline: RBI to conduct 4-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on November 09, 2026
stories.summary:
The Reserve Bank of India announced a 4-day auction on November 9, 2026.
It will lend up to ₹50,000 crore to commercial banks.
The auction will start at 9:30 AM and end at 10:00 AM.
The money will be returned by banks on November 13, 2026.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Supplying short-term cash to banks helps them manage daily cash needs smoothly.

stories.headline: Sectoral Deployment of Credit by NBFC – September 2026
stories.summary:
Credit given by non-banking financial companies grew 15.4 percent year-on-year in September 2026.
This is higher than the 13.3 percent growth recorded in September 2025.
The data was collected by the Reserve Bank of India from major non-banking lenders and housing finance firms.
The growth reflects rising loan demand.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher loan growth shows strong borrowing demand, which can increase profits for NBFCs and home loan providers.

stories.headline: M&M shares surge 5% after Q2 results, brokerages maintain bullish outlook
stories.summary:
Mahindra & Mahindra shares rose 5 percent after reporting second-quarter results.
The company's auto business profit margin improved by 0.58 percentage points over the previous quarter to 7.7 percent.
However, its farm equipment profit margin fell by 1.76 percentage points to 16.8 percent.
Brokerages maintained a positive outlook on the company.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong performance in the main vehicle division may support investor interest in auto shares.

stories.headline: Siemens Q2 Results: Profit grows 5% to Rs 504 crore
stories.summary:
Siemens Limited reported a net profit of ₹504 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Profit grew 4.78 percent compared to ₹481 crore in the previous year.
Revenue from operations increased to ₹5,734 crore from ₹4,900 crore.
New order bookings rose 38 percent to ₹6,228 crore.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong growth in new orders indicates good business activity for heavy engineering companies.

stories.headline: Ecom, qcom companies see consumer spending surge ahead of Diwali
stories.summary:
Festive season e-commerce order volumes increased by 21 percent compared to the same period last year.
Quick delivery shopping apps saw order volumes jump by 75 percent.
Growth was driven by customer purchases across gifting, fashion, and home decor products.
Consumers showed strong buying interest ahead of Diwali.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher spending by shoppers during festivals can boost earnings for retail and consumer product companies.

stories.headline: केंद्रीय मंत्री श्री अश्विनी वैष्णव ने सेमीकॉन 2.0 वेब एप्लिकेशन पोर्टल लॉन्च किया और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स कंपोनेंट्स मैन्युफैक्चरिंग स्कीम के तहत 12 स्वीकृत आवेदकों की घोषणा की
stories.summary:
The central government launched the Semicon 2.0 web portal.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced 12 approved applicants under the electronics components manufacturing scheme.
The initiative aims to expand domestic electronics production.
This step supports local tech manufacturing in India.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Government support for component making may encourage local manufacturing and benefit electronics companies.
